The '''Rules of Audience''' were a set of rules that were enforced by [[Gar (Gamorrean)|Gar]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who acted as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Slythor]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korad]]. The rules required that individuals who visited Slythor should address the Squib as "[[Highest Exalted Ruler of Korad|Highest Exalted Ruler]]," that they should only speak when asked a direct question by Slythor, that no-one should touch the Squib and that no-one was to lie to Slythor. Anyone who broke the rules was struck by Gar with his [[Vibro-glaive/Legends|vibroglaive]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Korad to speak with Slythor and prior to their meeting with the Squib, Gar explained the Rules of Audience to them.
